text:
In the world teetering on the brink of destruction, the chosen one, Kai, was destined to harness the ancient magic to restore balance. The original tale ends with Kai merging his spirit with the magic, becoming one with it and saving the world, but at the cost of his human existence. Alternative Ending:

Instead of surrendering his physical form, Kai discovered a third path hidden within the ancient runes. He realized that the magic did not require his life, but his *fear*. By confronting his deepest terror—the loss of his loved ones—Kai channeled his courage into the spell rather than his spirit. The magic surged through him, not consuming him, but amplifying his human will. The world was saved, and Kai remained, not as a god-like entity, but as a mortal guardian, forever changed but still human, able to walk among the people he saved.

The capital of France is Paris.
